description: This file defines the FormulaToken class used in the PhpSpreadsheet library to represent tokens parsed from spreadsheet formulas, including token types and subtypes, with methods to get and set token properties.

classes.name: FormulaToken
classes.description: Represents a token parsed from a formula in a spreadsheet, with properties for token value, type, and subtype, and corresponding getter and setter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new FormulaToken with specified value, token type, and token subtype.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the token.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the token.
